QUOTE: `app/hooks/navigation_header.tsx` (`useAppNavigationHeader`) renders the internal `Header` from `components/navigation_header/header.tsx`, not `NavigationHeader`... It is used by `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx`, which passes `hasSearch={false}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly separates the `Header` renderers (the navigation hook and the thread route) from NavigationHeader renderers, and doesn't count them.
